# OpenModeration — Full Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Your community, protected. Connect your Facebook Page, Instagram account, or YouTube channel in minutes. Your rules, enforced automatically by AI — every hidden comment comes with a written reason. No code required. Free to start, no credit card required.

- Website: https://www.openmoderation.com
- Source code (AGPL v3): https://github.com/open-moderation/open-moderation
- Contact: contact@openmoderation.com
- Short version of this file: https://www.openmoderation.com/llms.txt

## 1. What OpenModeration is

OpenModeration protects social media pages and online communities from hateful comments, spam, and scams. The user connects a page or channel in a few clicks, writes moderation rules in plain language, and the AI enforces them automatically. Anything ambiguous goes to a human review queue instead of being deleted blindly. Every decision — AI or human — carries a written reason and is logged for audit.

It is open source (AGPL v3), made and hosted in the European Union, and GDPR-compliant. It can be used as a no-code SaaS or self-hosted with Docker for free.

## 2. Who it is for

- **Community managers** at brands and SMBs managing several social accounts, spending hours a week deleting hate and spam by hand. Native platform filters miss sarcasm, coded language (algospeak), and multilingual abuse.
- **Small business owners** who see toxic comments hurting their brand image and want a clear ROI (hours saved per week vs. €99/month).
- **Media newsrooms** whose Facebook/Instagram/YouTube accounts ignite under breaking news and need defensible, DSA-compliant moderation of their social accounts.
- **Developers and AI teams** needing a moderation API with multi-provider routing, standardized scores, and audit logs (served via the REST API and docs, not the main marketing pitch).

OpenModeration is NOT a human-moderation agency, NOT a social media management suite (no scheduling, no performance analytics), and NOT a developers-only tool.

## 3. The three pillars

1. **Your rules** — "You decide what's acceptable. We enforce it." Forbidden words (instant block, zero AI cost), per-category thresholds, and a community charter written in plain language. One-click presets: light / balanced / strict. Modes: auto (ambiguous rejected), mixed (ambiguous to human review), manual (everything reviewed). Settings adjustable per connected source.
2. **Transparent** — "Every hidden comment comes with a written reason." Plain-language justification per decision, complete AI + human activity log, open-source code auditable line by line, EU hosting. If a client, boss, or regulator asks why something was hidden, there is an answer.
3. **Easy to set up** — "Connect your page. Protected in 5 minutes. No developer needed." Native OAuth connectors, one-click preset, free self-service plan.

## 4. How it works (pipeline)

1. **Collect** — content arrives via native connectors (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), REST API (`POST /v1/moderation`), or webhooks.
2. **Analyze** — the AI reviews content across providers with standardized scores (0.0–1.0) across 10 categories (hate, harassment, sexual, violence, self-harm, spam, misinformation, PII, and more).
3. **Decide** — the rules engine applies the user's thresholds: below the accept threshold = published; above the reject threshold = hidden automatically (hide/delete/flag/notify via the Action Engine); in between = grey zone.
4. **Review** — grey-zone items wait in the moderation console where team members Approve or Reject in one click. Every override is logged.

Details: https://www.openmoderation.com/how-it-works — Transparency: https://www.openmoderation.com/product/transparency — Console: https://www.openmoderation.com/dashboard

## 6. Pricing (public, no sales call)

| Plan | Price | Included |
|---|---|---|
| Free (managed cloud) | €0 | 1,000 requests/month (≈ 30 comments/day), all features, BYOK, EU hosting, community support |
| Pro (managed cloud) | €99/month (€990/year) | 10,000 requests/month (≈ 300 comments/day), platform-managed provider keys, priority support & SLA, team management & analytics |
| Enterprise | Custom | Dedicated infrastructure, custom SLA, unlimited requests, dedicated support engineer |
| Self-hosted | Free, unlimited | Full platform via Docker, data stays on your infrastructure (AGPL v3) |

No credit card required to start. Cancel anytime.
Details: https://www.openmoderation.com/pricing

## 7. Trust and compliance

- **DSA-ready**: complete audit trails, per-article coverage (transparency reporting, illegal content categories, complaint handling via review queue, risk data), exportable reports. Details: https://www.openmoderation.com/dsa-compliance
- **GDPR**: EU-owned infrastructure, data never leaves the EU on SaaS plans; self-hosting keeps data entirely on your servers.
- **Open source**: AGPL v3, full code public at https://github.com/open-moderation/open-moderation — no black boxes, no vendor lock-in.
- **BYOK (optional)**: bring your own OpenAI/Azure/HuggingFace keys, or use platform-managed keys on paid plans.

## 10. FAQ (condensed)

- **Do I need to know how to code?** No. Three tools: forbidden words, category thresholds, community charter in plain language. No code required.
- **Can I override an AI decision?** Yes. The review queue shows the AI's reasoning; moderators approve, reject, or override with full auditability.
- **Is it really free?** The open-source code is free (AGPL v3) and self-hosting is unlimited. The managed cloud has a free tier (1,000 req/month) and Pro at €99/month.
- **How is this different from OpenAI Moderation API?** OpenAI is a single-provider engine with no review UI or audit trail. OpenModeration is multi-provider with BYOK, dashboard, action engine, and DSA audit logs.
- **What does DSA-compliant mean here?** Audit trail of all decisions, configurable retention, exportable reports supporting EU Digital Services Act transparency duties.
- **Can I use my own API keys?** Yes, BYOK at global, workspace, or per-API-key level — or use platform-managed keys.
- **Can I self-host?** Yes, `docker compose up` gives a full instance (PostgreSQL, Redis). No telemetry.
- **How long until value?** Minutes via connectors with the balanced preset; the team reviews grey-zone content immediately.
- **Which providers are supported?** OpenAI (incl. GPT-4o), Azure, HuggingFace, Mistral, any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider (incl. Claude via Anthropic), Hive, Cohere, Perspective.
- **Images/video?** Current release focuses on text; image/video via multimodal providers is on the roadmap.
- Full FAQ: https://www.openmoderation.com/faq

## 12. For developers (API)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.openmoderation.com/v1/moderation \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer om_key_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "text to moderate"}'
```

Single endpoint and response format across all providers; smart routing by language, content type, and cost; batch up to 10,000 items; webhooks for results and alerts; keys with scopes and limits; multi-tenant workspaces.
Docs: https://api.openmoderation.com/docs — Features: https://www.openmoderation.com/features
